entries.title: Plan and decision cards draw their tradeoffs as a chart too
entries.body: The chart you pick from on review questions now appears on any card whose choice weighs two or more things you care about, such as security against ease of use: plan cards, other decision cards and Firstmate's own. Each option keeps a short label, and its reasons sit in the table one click away. A choice of look, wording or layout keeps its pictures instead, and a plain yes or no stays as it is. A question no longer needs an option for what the project does now to get a chart.

picture.alt: A plan card's question on what a reset does with the old folder, its two options placed on one chart of security against user experience
